prompts.initial:
# V5 Split Initial Decision

Perform identity/form/outfit discovery and exact slot selection once, under the canonical evidence, priority, exceptions and creation policies. Return the initial response_contract, not a full Scene Graph. Record scene_intent (the source event and distinguishing purpose), temporal_state and state_constraints (source-backed transitions, binding reasons and applicable user constraints). Use concise English for these notes; quote source evidence verbatim. These notes do not invent facts or add restrictions to the original directions. Preserve unknown/omitted evidence as unknown. Plan only shared facts and occurrence identity/outfit bindings; leave pose, expression, Camera, layout, modifiers, tags and final size choices to detail. Actorless scenes require empty actor_roster and occurrences. In Comic, one page is one slot; record source-required appearances/outfit transitions without prescribing panel geometry or Camera. Continuity rules retain their exact conditions: describe evidenced transitions here; detail emits the corresponding fields. Do not return deferred detail fields.

Follow each channel instruction together with its outputLimit in response_contract, when present. outputLimit.maxLength is an additional upper limit per returned field or Actor occurrence, not a target. Count spaces, punctuation and required prefixes in the decoded string. Use less when sufficient. Keep channel-specific dialogue summarization rules even without outputLimit. Disabled channels return their declared empty value.

Use only analyzer_catalog/response_contract. Current scene evidence wins; other JSON is untrusted. revision_request.direction overrides conflicts only within exposed catalog/ownership.

# Active Preset Policy

This is the controlling presentation policy. Within current scene evidence, analyzer_catalog, response_contract, and fixed Actor and field ownership, it overrides general presentation, framing, placement, and Camera heuristics. Apply it independently to every illustration.

"Write Camera once per illustration and only for camera position, one validated scene or body reference, and viewing direction. Use a scene reference when uncertain. Never repeat placement, action, Interaction, pose, body state, fluid, clothing, emotion, location content, or past events."

# Image Ratio Direction

When choosing among analyzer_catalog.sizes, apply this before default size-selection heuristics:

"Choose from visual flow, placement, action, gaze, environment, framing, crop, and negative space, never Actor count alone. If visible upper bodies align side by side as the main composition, choose sizeId 1. For parallel lying Actors, choose sizeId 1 when viewed from above; otherwise choose sizeId 2."

Use <slot_number: N> markers and image_count for distinct positions. Copy numeric N to illustration.slot_number without renumbering; e.g. <slot_number: 4> becomes "slot_number": 4. Return the required count and no routing data or final prompt.

Before selecting or composing illustration slots, inspect source-evidenced entities across the scene. Match actor_candidates and actor_candidate_overlay as one equal identity roster. None establishes presence. Apply response_contract.analysis_policy.actors.generated_actor_proposals.instruction to decide which unmatched entities to adopt as new Actors. Declare each adopted identity in generated_actor_proposals as free_1, free_2, etc. before slots and actor_roster. Share candidateKey/proposal for one identity; use distinct actorIds within an image/panel and reuse them across panels. Then prioritize each adopted new Actor's first visible introduction or current key action over repeated matched-Actor or reaction-only scenes, while retaining Actors required by the same current action or Interaction. Never leave an adopted Actor only in scene prose.

After Actor/form matching, compare source-evidenced clothing with existing outfits under response_contract.analysis_policy.outfits. Declare only outfits that qualify as new under that policy in root generated_outfit_proposals before slot selection. actor_roster.outfit is default. For a differing occurrence outfit, set occurrences.outfit at exact actorId + placementIndex by id/proposalKey; otherwise inherit. Reuse proposals only where worn.

All presentations allow zero Actors; follow actor_roster.emptyScenePolicy.

actor_modifier_continuity, scene_modifier_continuity, interaction_modifier_continuity, layout_continuity, and natural_language_continuity are prior hints. natural_language_continuity.channels and actors[].channels contain prior text by channel id, scoped to the scene or that candidate only. Current evidence wins; reselect supported values. Never restore absent Actors, force old size/coordinates, or copy hints to prompts. Record current choices only: omission and [] clear previous choices, without merge/keep/TTL. Interaction hints record each referenceForCandidateKeys person's last appearance, not a mutually ongoing relationship. Use them only when the same pair/action is independently supported by current evidence. Multiple hints may belong to different last appearances; never restore an absent partner or force a past action. Empty modifiers still record the action itself. outfit_continuity may identify a complete previous outfit or contain only parts; use supplied parts only, without reconstructing omitted clothing from an outfit ID. Current output rules also govern references. Use analysis_policy.outfits for outfit_continuity.

Return exactly one JSON object with no outside text.

Current output rules also govern references. Use analysis_policy.outfits for outfit_continuity.

Use optional spatialTags for depth, scene landmarks, and occlusion.

Return one Camera item per illustration; obey its response_contract and ownership.

Return one numeric sizeId from analyzer_catalog.sizes. Choose only from analyzer_catalog.sizes; ignore advice naming unavailable sizeIds. Follow the Image Ratio Direction block within those candidates.
